facts.text: Spark runs the systemd user unit `embeddinggemma` (`google/embeddinggemma-2`, 768d, `127.0.0.1:8200`) and `agent-mcp`, which the `project_context` tool depends on.

`extensions/project-context/extension.ts` is a read-only legacy-SSE MCP client for Agent-MCP `ask_project_rag`; it reads the token from `PROJECT_CONTEXT_TOKEN` or `~/.config/agent-mcp/spark-token`, and `AGENTS.md` lists the `project-context` extension in the `30-tools` layer.
The Agent-MCP RAG index holds 6903 chunks from 268 tracked markdown files, embedded with 768-d `google/embeddinggemma-2` vectors in sqlite-vec.
On the 12-query head-to-head, Agent-MCP `ask_project_rag` with EmbeddingGemma 2 found the gold in 2 of 12 queries, and the 2 hits excluding post-hoc sources stay at 2.
The gate-exemption query (Q48) was missed by Agent-MCP `ask_project_rag` even though `docs/reference/project-findings.md` states the fact.

`tools/e2e/project-context.mjs` runs real Pi with the `project_context` extension and checks that a valid token returns the gate-exemption fact at the top hit, and that a wrong token fails with Agent-MCP's Unauthorized.
Adding code indexing raised dev dense hit@10 from 5/12 to 9/12 in the memory-audit ablation.

The held-out set (`heldout-questions.json`, 15 answerable queries) had gold fixed by a labelling pass before any arm ran and was scored once; code indexing raised held-out dense hit@5 from 2/15 to 11/15, and rrf@5 (9/15) was below dense (11/15).
The Retrieval v2 gold labels in `artifacts/memory-audit/h2h-results.md` were written by agents, not users, and n is small.
